sections.body: Hold up one finger. ☝️ That is ONE.
Let's count together: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5! 🖐️ Five fingers on one hand.
Find 5 toys. Touch each one and count out loud.
Point to each object as your child counts so they match one number to one object. If they skip, gently start again together — no rush.

hints: Touch each star as you count.
Look: 🍎 🍎 — one apple, two apples. Now count the stars the same way.
Count: one, two, three… is there one more?
Look: 🐟🐟🐟 is three fish. Is there one more duck than that?
